name: Honda CBR1100XX Blackbird
engine: 1137 cc liquid-cooled inline four, carbs (1997-98) or fuel injected (1999-2007)
intro: Honda's big sport tourer. Early bikes have carbs, later ones are fuel injected. Linked brakes need care when bleeding.

G: 1997-1998 bikes have carbs. 1999-on bikes are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.
K: The front and rear brakes are linked. Bleed them in the order the manual gives.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
